This petition was called on for hearing today.
CORAM :
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURYA KANT  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE J.K. MAHESHWARI

For Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Siddharth Jain, Adv.
 Mr. Rishabh Jain, Adv.

 Mr. Krishan Kumar, AOR  For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

The High Court for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad vide impugned Judgment and Order dated 01032023 dismissed the Matrimonial Appeal filed by the petitioner (husband) against the Judgment and Decree dated 16042019, whereby the Family Court, Khammam granted a Decree of Divorce in favour of the respondent (wife).
2.

sentences.text: The petitioner was already settled in U.S.A. at that time.
The Respondent (wife) also joined him in U.S.A.
They came together on 18042015 to attend the wedding ceremony of the petitioners brother.
Thereafter, the petitioner (husband) went back to U.S.A. on 10052015.
There arose a matrimonial dispute thereafter and the respondent (wife) filed a Criminal Complaint under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), 1860 on 01102015.
Soon thereafter, she also filed a petition for dissolution of marriage on 06102015, which was decreed on 16042019.

As noticed, at the outset, the appeal preferred by the petitioner (husband)
has been dismissed by the High Court.
3. Both the Courts
have not accepted the allegations of cruelty or demand of dowry alleged by the respondent (wife) and rightly so.
Be that as it may, we find that it is a case of irretrievable breakdown of marriage where the parties are living separately since May, 2015.
During the pendency of the appeal, the High Court made repeated efforts for reconciliation but the parties did not cooperate.
There is no child born out of the wedlock.
4. In such circumstances, the Courts below have rightly dissolved the marriage.
5. No case to interfere with the impugned Judgment dated 01032023 passed by the High Court for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad, is made out.
6. The Special Leave Petition is, accordingly, dismissed.

(VISHAL ANAND) (PREETHI T.C.)
ASTT.
